name: typehtml-doctor
description: Doctor diagnostics for explicitly configured saved HTML snapshots

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs the workspace's locally installed TypeHTML CLI.

typehtml.doctorConfig.description: Doctor configuration JSON, relative to this workspace folder. Empty disables diagnostics. Only saved HTML snapshots listed by this config are analyzed.

typehtml.cliPath.description: Local TypeHTML CLI JavaScript file, relative to this workspace folder. Requires an installed TypeHTML package and Node.js 22+.

typehtml.nodePath.description: Node.js 22+ executable. This setting can only be configured in user settings; arguments are not accepted.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && node scripts/prepare.cjs && npm run build
